title: Answer: change blindness, sensory substitution, color naming and plasticity

statements.text: The checkable part is a set of perception experiments the approach prompted or predicts: change blindness, sensory substitution with active control, adaptation to inverting goggles, color naming, illusions of ownership and cortical deference after rerouting.

sources.quote: has provided the impetus for a series of surprising experiments on what has come to be known as change blindness
